subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After atomic sandbox append is implemented, should `append` become a permanent optional parameter on the core write tool?
rationale: This is a new model-facing core capability rather than a repair to an existing documented write-tool contract, so implementation correctness cannot determine the permanent API direction.

options.title: Adopt optional append
options.body: Land the parameter after atomic sandbox support, compatibility coverage, and real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Expose append as a distinct capability so overwrite policy and tool allowlists remain explicit.

options.title: Decline core expansion
options.body: Retain current write semantics and rely on specialized append paths or other existing tools.

recommendation.title: Adopt optional append
recommendation.body: Land the parameter after atomic sandbox support, compatibility coverage, and real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current write-tool surface and owns most of the merged sandbox mutation architecture affected by this decision.
